about: Puzzle levels for the machine (scripts/machine_game.py). Each machine is fixed; the player adds pieces from the tray. Every solution here is checked in the engine by tests/machine_game_tests.py.

levels.title: Mind the gap
levels.brief: The ball rolls down the ramp and along the table. Cut a plank to length and set it down over the gap, so the ball rolls across into the green cup.

goal.title: The ball is in the cup

hints: The gap is from x = 0 to x = 0.6. Each table has a ledge 2 cm lower and 10 cm wide at the gap: a 2 cm plank that rests on both ledges is level with the tables.
A plank is set down on whatever is under it, and then it is gravity that holds it there.

levels.title: Cut it down
levels.brief: The iron weight hangs on an oak rope over the bin. Swing a knife through the rope so the weight drops in.

goal.title: The weight is in the bin

hints: The rope hangs at x = 0, z = 0.235, from 0.53 m to 0.83 m up.
At the bottom of its swing the blade is about arm length + 0.03 m below the pivot, and its edge 6 cm ahead of the pivot.

levels.title: Knock it off
levels.brief: Aim the cannon at the block. Connect trigger Out to cannon +, then cannon − to supply − in Readings and wiring. Drag the trigger handle down to fire. Current heats the powder; gas pushes the ball, which knocks the block into the green zone.

handle.label: Drag to fire ↓
handle.help: Drag down until the trigger latches. Reset restores the open trigger.

goal.title: The block is in the zone

tray.label: Wire
tray.description: Connect two labelled electrical terminals; crossing lines never connect.

hints: The block is 0.45 m above the ground. A level shot drops during flight: adjust bore height, direction and powder.
Open Readings and wiring, choose Connect wires, then draw both firing leads. The existing supply lead powers the trigger; crossings do not connect.
Run it alone does not fire. Drag the trigger handle down; watch switch state and coil current in Readings and wiring. The coil must heat the powder before the ball moves.

levels.title: Up she goes
levels.brief: Raise a steam engine's piston into the green zone before time runs out. More heat is faster, and costs more.

goal.title: The piston is in the zone
goal.needs: Place a steam engine: the goal is its piston

hints: The zone is 0.95 m up, over x = 0.6, z = 0: stand the engine under it. Every kilowatt boils about 0.44 g of water a second, and each gram of steam fills about 1.7 litres.

levels.title: Chain reaction
levels.teaches: a chain: rolling, a switch, a powder charge
levels.brief: The cannon is wired to fire when the lever tips. Get a ball onto the lever, and the cannon will knock the block into the zone.

goal.title: The block is in the zone

cost_per.say: 1 per 10 cm of height at its top

hints: The lever is 0.8 m long, its middle at x = 0.6. A ball landing on its left half tips it far enough to close the switch.
A ball leaving a ramp's foot flies on; the higher the top, the faster and further.

levels.title: Bounce the beam
levels.teaches: light: reflection, and light heating what it lands on
levels.brief: The laser can burn through the cord holding the weight, but the wall is in the way. Bounce its beam off mirrors onto the cord.

goal.title: The weight is in the bin

hints: The laser fires along +x at 0.575 m up, from x = -0.81 at z = 0, about 4.5 kW of light in a beam 2 cm wide.
The cord hangs at x = -0.4, z = 1.015. A mirror turned 45 degrees sends a beam along x off into z; light leaves a mirror at the angle it came in.
Light reflects off a mirror's face, 1 cm in front of its middle.

levels.title: Catch the sun
levels.teaches: sunlight: a panel facing the sun catches the most
levels.brief: The winch runs on sunlight, but the sun is low behind the shed and its shadow is long. Set a panel down in the sun, turn and tip it to face the sun, then connect its output to the winch input with a power cable.

goal.title: The weight is up at the green mark

tray.label: Power cable
tray.description: An ideal two-conductor lead from a solar output to a battery input. Cable losses and mass are not modeled.

hints: The sun stands 15 degrees above the ground, behind the shed: toward -x and -z, half way between them.
A panel stores a fifth of the sunlight on its face. Facing the sun squarely it gets 250 W of sunlight; lying flat, about a quarter of that, because the sun meets it so slantwise.
The winch lifts the weight only with more than about 185 W of sunlight on the panel; with less its motor just warms. Turn the panel about -45 degrees, then tip it up.
Click the panel output, then the winch input to add a saved power cable. An unconnected panel charges only its own finite store; the winch battery starts empty.

levels.title: Lift with less
levels.teaches: mechanical advantage: a block and tackle
levels.brief: Lift the iron crate up to the shelf mark with a counterweight on a block and tackle. With more pulleys a lighter counterweight will do, but it has to fall further to lift the crate as far.

goal.title: The crate is up at the shelf mark
goal.needs: Hang a counterweight on the block and tackle first.

hints: The crate is 13.6 kg of iron. With n pulleys the counterweight pulls the crate n times as hard as its own weight, and the crate rises 1/n as far as the counterweight falls.
The shelf mark starts 0.49 m above the crate's middle, so the counterweight must fall n times that before it reaches the ground.
A counterweight no heavier than the crate divided by n does not move at all.

free.title: Free build
free.brief: Build anything. Every piece is here, as many as you like: hold marbles up high on a shelf behind a gate, run them down tracks, send them left and right with a flip-flop, knock down dominoes. Press Run it and watch: the engine works out every roll, bounce and fall.
hints: Set out the example to see one way: a marble rolls onto a gate's paddle, the gate opens, the marbles waiting on the shelf roll down to a flip-flop, and it sends them to the dominoes or to a stop.
A shelf tilts a little toward its gate, so marbles set down on it roll to the gate and wait there.
A gate opens when its short arm, out past the rail, is pressed down: drop a marble on it from a track above, tip a lever under it, or pull it.
A flip-flop sends marbles dropped on its middle one way, then the other. Put a track's end just above its pin, and a track under each end.
